title: Click a dark blue rack in RMS to view which tote is associated to that rack
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI map to verify which tote number is currently associated with a specific rack location. Dark blue/violet rack locations indicate a tote is present; clicking the rack reveals the tote number so you can compare it to the expected tote for that rack position and detect mismatches.
when_to_use: When you need to confirm the tote number RMS shows for a particular rack position (e.g., to validate whether the correct tote is on the expected sorter destination rack).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS map interaction to identify the tote number associated with a dark blue/violet rack and compare it to the expected tote number.

visual_references.description: Training frame showing rack locations and the rule: dark blue/violet rack indicates a tote is on the rack; clicking the rack reveals the tote number associated with that rack.

steps.title: Open RMS / fleet status UI and locate the rack position to verify
steps.purpose: Get to the RMS map view where rack locations can be clicked to reveal the associated tote.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (map view) and find the rack location you want to verify.
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the target rack location on the RMS map.
steps.healthy_condition: The target rack location is visible and has a color state you can distinguish (dark blue/violet vs lighter blue).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the rack location on the RMS map, or you cannot distinguish the rack color state.

actions.label: Locate rack on RMS map
actions.exact_action: Find the rack location you want to verify in the RMS / fleet status UI (RMS/map view).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When a rack is dark blue, if you click on it, it will tell you what tote you have on the rack itself.

steps.title: Confirm the rack is dark blue/violet (tote present)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are clicking a rack state that indicates a tote is present, per the RMS color convention.
steps.instruction: Confirm the rack location color is dark blue (almost like a violet).
steps.expected_result: The rack location you plan to click is dark blue/violet, indicating a tote is on that rack.
steps.healthy_condition: Dark blue/violet rack tone is present (tote present).
steps.failure_condition: The rack appears lighter blue (indicating empty) or you cannot determine the rack color tone.

actions.label: Check rack color tone
actions.exact_action: Confirm the rack has the dark blue tone (tote present).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: There are two distinct color on this rack. If a rack has this dark blue tone, it means it has a tote on it. If it has the light blue tote, it means it's empty.

steps.title: Click the dark blue rack location on the RMS map
steps.purpose: Trigger RMS to display the tote number associated with that rack.
steps.instruction: Click the dark blue rack location on the RMS map.
steps.expected_result: RMS updates to show the tote identifier/number associated with the clicked rack.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking, a tote number/identifier is displayed for that rack.
steps.failure_condition: No tote number/identifier appears after clicking, or the displayed tote number is clearly inconsistent with the rack’s expected state.

actions.label: Click rack
actions.exact_action: Click on the dark blue rack location on the map.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The other thing is that when you when a rack is dark blue, if you click on it, it will tell you what tote you have on the rack itself.

steps.title: Read the tote number shown for the clicked rack
steps.purpose: Capture the system-reported tote number associated with the rack for comparison to the expected tote.
steps.instruction: Observe the tote identifier/number displayed for that rack after clicking.
steps.expected_result: A tote number/identifier is visible in RMS for the clicked rack.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote number/identifier is readable and corresponds to the clicked rack location.
steps.failure_condition: The tote number/identifier is missing, unreadable, or does not correspond to the clicked rack location.

actions.label: Record displayed tote number
actions.exact_action: Observe the tote identifier/number displayed for that rack after clicking.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: When a rack is dark blue, if you click on it, it will tell you what tote you have on the rack itself.

steps.title: Compare displayed tote number to expected tote number for that rack position
steps.purpose: Determine whether RMS matches the expected tote placement at that rack position.
steps.instruction: Compare the tote number displayed in RMS to the expected tote number for that rack position (for example, if someone reports tote HV 110 but RMS shows 113).
steps.expected_result: You determine whether the displayed tote number matches or mismatches the expected tote number for the rack position.
steps.healthy_condition: Displayed tote number matches the expected tote number for that rack position.
steps.failure_condition: Displayed tote number does not match the expected tote number for that rack position.

actions.label: Compare tote numbers
actions.exact_action: Compare the displayed tote number to the expected tote number for that rack position.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the displayed tote number does not match the expected tote number for the rack position.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: So if someone's telling you like I see HV 110 on this rack and then you click on the rack and you see 113... you see... there's something wrong with it. It's not the right tote.

success_criteria: RMS shows a tote number after clicking the dark blue/violet rack location.
The displayed tote number matches the expected tote number for the rack position (or you escalate when it does not).
healthy_conditions: After clicking, RMS displays a tote number/identifier for that rack.
Displayed tote number matches the expected tote number for that rack position.
failure_conditions: Rack is not dark blue/violet (appears light blue indicating empty) when you expect a tote.
After clicking, RMS does not display a tote number/identifier for the rack.
Displayed tote number does not match the expected tote number for the rack position.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when the displayed tote number after clicking the rack does not match the expected tote number for that rack position.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Rack location color convention (dark blue/violet vs lighter blue) and the statement that clicking a dark blue rack reveals the tote on that rack.
